text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш needs to build experience,
but not by
constantly running
scrimmages. No, what she
needs is to
compete with a Derby champion.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After coming to this conclusion, I seek
Symboli
Rudolf for help. She suggests I
ask Мистер Си Би, a
Triple Crown champion,
for partner running.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мистер Си Би readily agrees and defeats
Eishin Flash
almost effortlessly. The race
gives her firsthand
experience of what it
takes to win the Derby.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Specifically, it's "the desire to win," and
though
she questions Мистер Си Би's abstract
advice, Eishin
Flash seems to have
learned something from it.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
